title: POS Sync — refund v1
description: Money and usually goods coming back. Omit line_items for a full refund of the referenced sale; include a subset for a partial one, which is the case most integrations get wrong.

external_id.description: The refund's own id — NOT the sale's. Stable across retries.

sale_external_id.description: The sale being refunded. May reference a sale not yet received: out-of-order delivery is normal, so the refund is held rather than rejected.

restock.description: Defaults to true. Send false for damaged goods that should not go back on the shelf — the money returns, the stock does not.

partial.description: Declares this as a partial refund of the referenced sale. A store driver that cannot do partials refuses it rather than silently refunding everything.

quantity.description: Positive — the quantity coming back, not a negative sale.
